title:
Your day.
Your way.
subtitle: A little place for your life.
voice: Your day deserves more than a forgotten note. Meet Wispr Diary.

title:
A book
of your
own.
subtitle: Choose the title. Make the cover yours.
voice: Make a book of your own. Give it a title, choose a cover, and make a little space for your day.

title:
A little
hello.
subtitle: A quick tour. Then it is all yours.
voice: A short welcome shows you where everything lives. Skip it anytime, or come back to the tour from the Book menu.

title:
Say it.
Keep it.
subtitle: Speak or type. Let the story grow.
voice: Tell the story of your day, or type it. Your words belong on the page, with more room whenever you need it.

title:
Keep the
little
things.
subtitle: Sticky notes, made for passing thoughts.
voice: Diary, add note: remember the little things. Keep a thought on a sticky note, and move it around by its grip.

title:
More than
words.
subtitle: Photos. Video. The sound of a memory.
voice: Bring the day back with a photograph, a video, or a voice recording. Keep each memory right beside your words.

title:
Find your
way back.
subtitle: Your pages, with a place for every chapter.
voice: Choose lined or blank paper, and a page color you love. Contents brings you back to any part of your story.

title:
A shelf
full of
you.
subtitle: Your account. Your books. Your stories.
voice: Your books stay in your account. Save unfinished thoughts in Ideas for Later, until they find their page.

title:
Less typing.
More living.
subtitle: WISPR DIARY
voice: Wispr Diary. Less typing. More living.
